data.title: Chevening Scholarships (UK)
data.summary: Fully funded one-year master's at a UK university for people with leadership potential and at least two years' work experience.
data.routeNote: Apply online on the Chevening website — there is no nominating agency. You choose three UK courses and write four essays; an unconditional university offer is needed later, if you are selected.
data.usualWindow: Opens in early August and closes in early October (2027/28 cycle: 4 August – 6 October 2026).
prepare: Two years (about 2,800 hours) of work experience after your degree
Three UK course choices and four essays (leadership, networking, studying in the UK, career plan)
A plan to return home for at least two years after the award

cycle.label: 2027/28 cycle
cycle.note: Interviews run February–April 2027; results come from mid-June 2027.
